proposals.before: Working with Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Xiao Dexiu, he revised the statutes. The emperor addressed Shucheng: "At present the penalties in our statutes are inconsistent in severity.
proposals.after: Working with Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Xiao De, he revised the statutes. The emperor addressed Shucheng: "At present the penalties in our statutes are inconsistent in severity.
proposals.reason: Chinese 與樞密副使蕭德修定法令 parses as Xiao De (蕭德) plus verb 修定 “revise,” not a personal name Xiao Dexiu.

proposals.before: With Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Xiao Dexiu he revised the statutes. The emperor issued an edict to Shucheng saying: "At present the statutes' severity and leniency are not in proper order.
proposals.after: With Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Xiao De he revised the statutes. The emperor issued an edict to Shucheng saying: "At present the statutes' severity and leniency are not in proper order.
proposals.reason: Same misparse of 蕭德修定 as the name Xiao Dexiu; 修定 means revise.

proposals.before: Early in Xianyong his fief was transferred to Qi. Summoned to court, he received the title Meritous Minister of Shared Virtue, was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with concurrent appointment as Central Secretariat Director, and was appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs. His fief was then changed to Jin, he was granted the attendants allotted to both the chancellor's and the commissioner's offices, and he was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
proposals.after: Early in Xianyong his fief was transferred to Qi. Summoned to court, he received the title Meritorious Minister of Shared Virtue, was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with concurrent appointment as Central Secretariat Director, and was appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs. His fief was then changed to Jin, he was granted the attendants allotted to both the chancellor's and the commissioner's offices, and he was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
proposals.reason: English typo: Meritous should be Meritorious for 功臣.

decisions.reason: 與樞密副使蕭德修定法令 is Xiao De (蕭德) plus 修定 “revise the statutes,” not a name Xiao Dexiu; s0016’s 從宜修定 confirms 修定 as the verb.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 與樞密副使蕭德修定法令

decisions.reason: Same parse: 蕭德 is the personal name and 修定法令 the action; the literal must not glue 修 into the name Xiao Dexiu.
同德功臣 is a meritorious-minister honor; English “Meritous” is a misspelling of “Meritorious,” and the rest of the sentence matches 咸雍初…封趙王.
Same typo fix for 同德功臣: “Meritorious” is the correct English spelling in the literal field.
保節功臣 likewise requires “Meritorious,” not the misspelled “Meritous,” in the idiomatic title.
Same spelling correction for 保節功臣 in the literal field; no other wording change is needed.
